tactics.title: Taktiktavle
tactics.name: Planens navn
tactics.noLevel: Indlæs en bane under Bane for at planlægge på den; uden en er tavlen en flad plan.
tactics.hint.select: Click a figure, waypoint, route, area or note to select it; Shift+click adds or removes, Shift+drag draws a box, Ctrl+A takes everything in this step. Delete removes the selection (after asking).
tactics.hint.place: Klik på banen for at sætte den valgte figur der. R drejer den.
tactics.hint.throw: Click the thrower, then where it should land: the ring is how far this throw reaches, a landing past it comes in to its edge, and the arc is the real flight. The chosen utility appears where it lands.
tactics.hint.note: Click where the note goes and type its text; its colour, size and when it shows are set below, and for a selected note in Selected.
tactics.hint.erase: Click a figure, route, area, note or drawing to remove it from this step on.
tactics.hint.moving: Klik, hvor den valgte figur skal stå i dette trin.
tactics.hint.finish: Enter, a double click, a right click or Esc finishes it; Backspace takes the last point back.
tactics.figureScaleHint: 1× er ægte størrelse; større er lettere at se langt oppefra.
tactics.label: Etiket
tactics.clearConfirm: Ryd hele planen? Fortryd henter den tilbage.
tactics.file.bad: That file is not a board this viewer reads: {reason}
tactics.addStep: Tilføj et trin; figurerne starter det, hvor deres ruter sluttede
tactics.valorant.failed: Kunne ikke hente kortene fra valorant-api.com: {reason}
tactics.gizmo.title: Transformér
tactics.gizmo.hint: Træk en pil for at flytte langs den, en firkant hen over dens plan, midten hen over banen; ringene roterer. Hold Ctrl for at fastgøre til gitteret eller vinkeltrinnet. Esc afbryder et træk.
tactics.speed.source.official: Hastigheder fra spillets offentliggjorte værdier (se Bevægelseshastigheder i dokumentationen).
tactics.speed.source.approx: Omtrentlige hastigheder (målt eller typiske; se Bevægelseshastigheder i dokumentationen). Angiv dine egne, hvor du ved bedre.
tactics.route.title: Rute: {total} s, fremme kl. {at}
tactics.timing.title: Timing
tactics.timing.realTime: Play in real time (a step lasts until its slowest route arrives); either way no figure moves faster than its top speed
tactics.timing.hint: Tiderne følger banens overflade og hældning ved hver tilstands hastighed for figuren; CS2-kort er i spilenheder (39,37 pr. meter).
tactics.timeline.title: Ankomster
tactics.tele.title: Sammenlign med kampdata
tactics.tele.hint: Indlæs CS2-kamptabeller for dette kort (eller brug de indlæste data) for at se, hvor hurtigt spillere faktisk nåede derhen, hvor din plan går.
tactics.tele.noRounds: de indlæste data har ingen rundetider
tactics.tele.speedsHint: Reelle hastigheder i m/s, mellem målinger under bevægelse.
tactics.tele.noStates: Dataene har ingen kolonner for bevægelsestilstand (gå, sidde på hug).
tactics.tele.compareHint: Markér en figur med rute eller dens rute for at sammenligne tiden med, hvad spillerne opnåede.
tactics.tele.compare: Hurtigst observeret {fastest} s ({who}), p10 {p10} s, median {median} s over {n} forsøg; din plan {plan} s.
tactics.tele.none: Ingen spiller i dataene gik derfra og dertil.
tactics.hint.waypoints: Click a figure, then each waypoint: it walks them when played. With several figures selected, the route is the group's (each keeps its place in the group). Begun off every figure it is a free arrow.
tactics.hint.measure: Click points to measure the way through them in metres, with the time it takes running.
tactics.draft.finish: {n, plural, one {# waypoint} other {# waypoints}}{group, plural, one {} other { for # figures}} · Enter, double click, right click or Esc to finish
tactics.measure.label: {m} m · {run} s running
tactics.removeConfirm: {n, plural, one {Remove the selected item?} other {Remove the # selected items?}} Undo brings it back.
tactics.layers.title: Layers
tactics.layers.activeHint: New figures, routes, areas, notes and drawings go on this layer.
tactics.layers.renameHint: Click to draw on it, double-click to rename it.
tactics.layers.shown: Shown: what is on it is drawn and played. Hidden: neither.
tactics.layers.locked: Locked: drawn and played, but nothing on it can be picked or changed.
tactics.layers.duplicateHint: A copy of the active layer to work on; the original is hidden, and routes of figures on other layers stay those figures' routes.
tactics.layers.upHint: Move the layer up: its routes play over the ones below
tactics.layers.removeConfirm: Remove the layer {name} and the {n} things on it? Undo brings them back.
tactics.layers.only: Draw only the active layer's routes (the others still play)
tactics.layers.lockedActive: The active layer is locked: nothing new can go on it.
tactics.layers.conflicts: {n, plural, one {# figure has} other {# figures have}} routes in this step on more than one shown layer; the upper layer's route plays.
tactics.layers.hint: Put each squad, plan or alternative on its own layer. Hide a layer to leave it out of the view and of playback; lock it to keep it from being changed.
tactics.author: Your name
tactics.authorPlaceholder: Signed on saved boards and shared edits
tactics.autosave.restored: The board you left was restored from this browser ({at}).
tactics.autosave.full: The board is too large for this browser to keep: save it to a file.
tactics.autosave.none: The board is kept in this browser a moment after each change, where the browser allows it.
tactics.speed.top: Top speed {v} m/s ({kmh} km/h): no route, wanted time or move between steps makes it faster.
tactics.keys.title: Keyframes at {at} ({s} s)
tactics.keys.remove: Remove the key at this moment
tactics.keys.aiming: Click on the level where it should point at this moment; Esc stops.
tactics.keys.hint: Angles from the hull's forward, right and up positive. Pick the moment with the time slider under the view; between keys a value turns the short way, before the first and after the last it holds.
tactics.keys.offBoard: The figure is not on the board at this moment.
tactics.route.wantHint: When to be at this waypoint, seconds from the step's start: the way there is spread to arrive then, never faster than the figure's top speed.
tactics.route.late: Waypoint {point}: wanted at {want} s, but at top speed it gets there at {got} s.
tactics.checks.none: Every figure keeps within its top speed.
tactics.checks.title: Speed limits ({n})
tactics.checks.late: Step {step}: {who} cannot be at waypoint {point} by {given} s; at top speed it is there at {needs} s.
tactics.checks.slide: Step {step}: {who} moves to its next place without a route; at top speed that takes {needs} s, so the step lasts that long instead of {given} s.
tactics.checks.squeezed: Step {step}: {who}'s route takes {needs} s at top speed; the step lasts that long instead of its set {given} s.
tactics.timeHint: Drag to see the plan at any moment and to set keyframes there; ▶ plays from here.
tactics.hint.draw: Drag on the level to draw with the pen or the highlighter; for a circle click the middle, then the edge. The camera does not turn while this tool is in hand: fly with the keys, or turn with the right button.
tactics.note.startNowHint: Start it at the moment shown (the time slider)
tactics.throw.reach: Reaches {m} m on the flat (launched at {speed} m/s, gravity {g} m/s²).
tactics.throw.src.public: Real-world figures; the game may differ.
tactics.mission.hint: A mission file as the starting board: DCS World (.miz) or Arma 3 (mission.sqm). Each side goes on its own layer.
tactics.mission.replace: Put the mission in place of the board? Undo brings the board back.
tactics.mission.done: Read {units} units in {groups} groups, {airbases} airbases and FARPs, {zones} zones and {markers} markers; each side is on its own layer.
tactics.mission.map: Set on {map}: load that level to plan on its ground.
tactics.dcs.openHint: En DCS World-mission (.miz) som tavle: hver koalition på sit eget lag, hver gruppe med sine enheder, sin rute og sine opgaver. »Gem som DCS-mission« skriver tavlen tilbage i den.
tactics.dcs.saveHint: Skriver tavlen som DCS World-mission: ind i den mission, den kom fra, eller som en ny mission til et operationsområde.
tactics.dcs.counts: {groups, plural, one {# gruppe} other {# grupper}}, {units, plural, one {# enhed} other {# enheder}}, {waypoints, plural, one {# waypoint} other {# waypoints}}
tactics.dcs.base.patchNone: den mission, den kom fra (ikke åben)
tactics.dcs.missing: {name}.miz er ikke åben i denne session: vælg den igen for at skrive ind i den, eller skriv en ny mission.
tactics.dcs.nothing: Intet ændret: filen ville være den samme.
tactics.dcs.untouched: {n, plural, one {# gruppe efterladt, som den var} other {# grupper efterladt, som de var}}
tactics.dcs.warnings: Hvad missionen ikke kan rumme, sådan som tavlen har det
tactics.dcs.warn.retyped: {group}: en enhed, der er skiftet til en anden slags, er nu en {what}; tjek dens bevæbning og bemaling i Mission Editor.
tactics.dcs.warn.airfield-dropped: {group}: en start eller landing på en flyveplads er ikke længere på ruten.
tactics.dcs.warn.ground: {group}: {n, plural, one {# waypoint tegnet på jorden flyves} other {# waypoints tegnet på jorden flyves}} i højden for waypointet før.
tactics.dcs.warn.removed: {n, plural, one {# gruppe taget ud: triggere, der nævner den, finder den ikke længere.} other {# grupper taget ud: triggere, der nævner dem, finder dem ikke længere.}}
tactics.dcs.warn.static: {group}: objekter på tavlen, der ikke er enheder, skrives ikke.
tactics.dcs.warn.no-country: {group}: missionen har intet land på den side at placere den i.
tactics.dcs.warn.new-air: {group}: en ny flight starter i luften med standardbrændstof og uden våben; indstil dem i Mission Editor.
tactics.dcs.warn.type-guess: {what}: ingen egen DCS-type, skrevet som den nævnte.
tactics.dcs.warn.fuel: {what}: standardmængde brændstof; tjek den i Mission Editor.
tactics.dcs.warn.patrol-ground: {group}: DCS har ingen patruljeopgave for landenheder eller skibe; ruten skrives uden den.
tactics.dcs.warn.air-only: {group}: {what} er en opgave kun for luftfartøjer.
tactics.dcs.warn.sweep-ground: {group}: DCS har ingen sweep-opgave for landenheder.
tactics.dcs.warn.no-target: {group}: {what} har brug for en anden gruppe på tavlen at virke på.
tactics.dcs.warn.state: {group}: {what} har en tilstand, som denne slags enhed ikke har i DCS.
tactics.dcs.warn.game-task: {group}: {what} er ikke en opgave, tavlen kan skrive; den udelades.
tactics.dcs.warn.skipped: {n, plural, one {# figur er ikke en enhed (markører, våben) og skrives ikke.} other {# figurer er ikke enheder (markører, våben) og skrives ikke.}}
tactics.dcs.warn.start: Opgaver, der er sat til at starte senere end deres waypoint, starter ved waypointet i DCS.
tactics.wt.openHint: En War Thunder-brugermission (.blk, som Mission Editor gemmer den) som tavle: hver hær på sit eget lag, hver enhed med sine waypoints. »Gem som War Thunder-mission« skriver tavlen tilbage i den.
tactics.wt.saveHint: Skriver tavlen som War Thunder-brugermission: ind i den mission, den kom fra, eller som en ny mission på en bane.
tactics.wt.missing: {name}.blk er ikke åben i denne session: vælg den igen for at skrive ind i den, eller skriv en ny mission.
tactics.dcs.warn.wt-task: {group}: {what} kræver en trigger i War Thunders Mission Editor; den skrives ikke.
tactics.dcs.warn.wt-count: {group}: en War Thunder-enhed er én flight eller deling; {n, plural, one {# figur på tavlen forbliver} other {# figurer på tavlen forbliver}} én enhed.
tactics.dcs.warn.wt-player: Ingen blå enhed til spilleren: vælg en i Mission Editor.
